I have only this small piece of land, and I am too old to carry heavy fertilizer bags from the cooperative. I will put cow dung from my animals on the plot before planting, and I will use the maize seed I saved from last year. My children will come to help with the digging and weeding, but I have no money to hire anyone from outside.
